title: Multi-Scale Flank-Warp, Sub-Grid 3DEP LiDAR/10m/Chi Geomorphology & GeoDAWN/INGENIOUS Hydrothermal Conduit Fusion with Spatial-OOF Kernel Regression and 300 m Submodular Cover

experiments.purpose: Isolate multi-resolution physical feature + spatial-OOF kernel-target surface gain over reproduced CTRL_A2_v2 under identical nms0_B3 emitter at 44,090 and 50,000 dots on the repaired nearest-exact-mask-v2 cache.

Evaluate exact 300 m triangular-kernel lazy-heap submodular cover on the same E1 out-of-fold predictions against CTRL_A2_v2 at 37,654, 44,090, and 50,000 dots; freeze a single winning configuration before touching seed 30.

Zero-retune replication on independent whole-component draw seed=30 against CTRL_A2_v2, followed by pre-placement surface check across all 1,103 accessible rasters, production GeoTIFF emission, verify_tif check, and full 1,103-raster final-dot audit.
